titles.title: Off the End of the Boat on a River Trip

description: Blue pen on paper. The walls of a canyon, sketched in blue ink, create a V shape at the center of the composition. A river runs between the walls. The sketch sits at the center of an expanse of blank white paper.
title: Off the End of the Boat on a River Trip
